# The Steak House on The Verandah — Comprehensive Dossier

## Practice & Estate Profile
- Business Name: The Steak House on The Verandah
- Entity: The Steak House on The Verandah LLC
- Address: 15276 (Devon House, 26 Hope Road), Kingston 10, Jamaica
- Geo Coordinates: 18.0148763, -76.7898652

## Historical Heritage
Built upon the ground of Jamaica's first black millionaire George Stiebel's 1881 Devon House landmark estate. Guests dine on breezy colonial verandahs surrounded by manicured courtyard gardens, Jamaican mahogany, and warm antique gas lantern lighting.

## Culinary Offerings
1. Prime Himalayan Dry-Aged Steaks: 45-day dry-aged Tomahawk, USDA Prime Bone-in Ribeye, Blue Mountain coffee-rubbed tenderloin, New York Strip.
2. Ocean Specialities: Wild-caught Caribbean rock lobster tail, pan-seared snapper, escovitch beurre blanc, jumbo garlic prawns.
3. Pasta & Purees: Hand-rolled saffron fettuccine, truffled potato puree, wild chanterelle reduction.
4. Cellar & Cocktails: Appleton Estate 21-Year Old reserve rum flights, Napa Valley cabernet sauvignons, vintage Grand Cru Bordeaux, smoked thyme old fashioneds.
5. Artisanal Desserts: Devon House rum-infused bread pudding, dark chocolate mousse dome with passion fruit coulis.

## Seating Areas
- Devon House Grand Verandah (al-fresco historic colonial arches)
- Private Mahogany Dining Room (intimate celebrations, executive dining)
- Courtyard Garden Terrace (starlit garden atmosphere)
- The 1881 Cellar Lounge (sommelier tastings and aperitifs)
